svg.title: FR-04 — Adjust a session's seat capacity

g.text: FR-04 — Adjust a session's seat capacity
Allowed for DRAFT and PUBLISHED events.
A CANCELLED event refuses the change,
but no use case on main cancels an event.
Seats already held or confirmed are kept
quantity would exceed the new capacity (FR-06).
No processed-event check here: applying the
same absolute capacity twice is harmless.
